'''Kepitenochan''' was a [[city]] located on the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] [[planet]] [[Kashyyyk]], [[homeworld]] of the [[Sentience|sentient]] [[Wookiee]] [[species]].<ref name="BMF 43" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Kepitenochan was introduced in the [[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 43|forty-third]] issue of the [[De Agostini]] ''[[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon]]'',<ref name="BMF 43" /> which was published around [[October 28]], [[2015]].<ref name="BMFdate">{{BuildFalconDates|43}}</ref> The [[Kepitenochan/Legends|city]] originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it first appeared in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''.<ref name="Galactic Battlegrounds">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>
